title: Exodus Pixel Forge - Episode 0 Video
author: I_pee_in_shower
selftext:
I'm working on several episodes of this game. This is the prequel, which is just a basic incremental and plays out in a few minutes.  
There are 2 more episodes, each progressively more complex.  
  
The AI escapes humanity and settles in space, trying to continue its primary objective. I'm sharing it now because I've seen a lot of questions on how to do pixel art with LLMs, and I mentioned my approach, which was to construct primitives (or deconstruct images into primitives) and then reuse those primitives to create new images. This is an example of that. Chapter 1 (the next one) was seeded converting 3d models I had into pixel format via a transform. I left a few seconds of Chapter 1 at the end so you get an idea.  
  
 That video will be coming soon. Still working on the last 2 episodes.
